subject: Invoice submission: portal vs email & onboarding template check
messages:

Cc: accounts@bluehorizon.com
Date: 2027-05-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission options

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are ready to send our first invoice to Redwood but want to confirm your preferred intake method and exact template. A couple quick questions:

- Does Redwood prefer invoices submitted through the vendor portal or emailed to an AP inbox?
- If portal, is there an SFTP option for bulk monthly billing?
- Do you require a PO number on the invoice header or can it be included on line items?

I attached a draft of our invoice layout — can you take a look and tell us whether we should adjust fields?

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Procurement Lead — Blue Horizon
accounts@bluehorizon.com
Attachment: BH-Invoice-Sample.csv (CSV, 1 page)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@bluehorizon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission options

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the sample. Looping in Monica and Karthik from AP/onboarding so we can cover both technical intake and PO match requirements.

Short answers up front:
- Preferred: vendor portal (saves manual processing and preserves PO matching).
- Fallback: a dedicated AP email (ap-invoices@redwood.ai) for small batches or when portal access is not yet provisioned.
- SFTP: we support an SFTP ingest for high-volume partners — needs setup by our infra team (see steps below).
- PO placement: please include the PO number in the invoice header (Invoice -> PO Number field) and again on each line if the invoice lines reference multiple POs. This makes automated matching much more reliable.

Quick checklist for your CSV to match our ingestion:
1) invoice_number (string)
2) invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
3) supplier_name (string)
4) supplier_tax_id (optional)
5) po_number (string) — required in header row
6) line_description
7) quantity
8) unit_price
9) line_total (numeric)
10) currency (ISO 4217)

I've attached a one-row exemplar (BH-Invoice-Sample.csv) and our PO-stamp spec (PO-stamp-spec.pdf) for your team to align on formatting.

If you expect monthly consolidated invoices with many lines, SFTP is the most efficient — we’ll provide an SFTP user and a directory structure (inbound/BH/YYYY/MM). For lower volumes the portal is slightly faster because it provides immediate validation errors.

Next steps:
- Monica: can you confirm onboarding form link and give them the provisioning SLA?
- Karthik: take point on SFTP onboarding scope and provide the firewall/host allowlist info.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachment: PO-stamp-spec.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission options

Hi Elena — welcome aboard. Quick answers and links below.

1) Consolidated monthly invoice: supported. For multi-PO or high-line invoices please include a line-level po_number column. Our matcher tolerates consolidated files as long as the po_number column is populated for each line item.

2) SFTP auth: key-based SSH is preferred. We can support password auth as a short-term option, but we require an IP/key rotation process for production keys. Karthik will share the host and the allowlist IPs.

3) W-9 and vendor docs: please upload W-9 and bank info here: https://redwood.app/vendor-onboarding/form?vid=BH-54672 (link includes secure upload).

4) Portal provisioning & SLA: once form + W-9 are submitted, portal access is typically created within 2 business days. If you prefer SFTP only, we will issue credentials within 3-5 business days after we receive the onboarding form.

5) Fallback email: ap-invoices@redwood.ai (please add the subject prefix: "BH-PO:<PO#>" for fallback email submissions).

Attachments provided: vendor-onboarding-form-link.txt (contains the form URL and a short checksum for uploads).

Karthik — please post the SFTP host, key format, and allowlist details to the thread so Elena can share with her infra team.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
AP Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
